verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a developer tool such as a package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only CLI commands (nix-shell, nix develop, nix repl, nix build) and package-management features, with no mention of any built-in AI assistant or task delegation. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
